prompt: You need to install a meta-bromo on acetophenone. Which order of operations works?

options.label: Friedel–Crafts acylation of benzene (acetyl chloride/AlCl₃), THEN Br₂/FeBr₃ (ketone directs meta).
Br₂/FeBr₃ on benzene first, then FC acylation (works but Br is o/p director — not meta).

explanation: Install the deactivating/meta-directing group (acyl) first; the ketone then directs incoming Br to the meta position.
